tests: Copy and Paste of a file with no extension in a folder whose name holds a dot creates nothing and says nothing
steps:
1. In Project Explorer, open Miscellaneous/v1.2 and select the file datafile, which has no extension.
2. Press Ctrl+C, then Ctrl+V: no file is added and nothing is said.
Control: Copy and Paste of a file makes a copy named '<name> copy' beside it.
